title: Schneider drivers building legacy of safety, one mile at a time
summary: Hundreds of drivers celebrated for safe driving milestones, demonstrating how the company’s continuous training and support help drivers build thriving, long-term careers Schneider National, Inc. (NYSE: SNDR), a premier multimodal provider of transportation, intermodal and logistics services, is celebrating hundreds of drivers for reaching new safety milestones while delivering reliable performance for shippers. Beyond these remarkable individuals, the awards also reflect Schneider’s responsible leadership in investing in drivers for the long haul and providing them with training, equipment and tools to be successful.
